text:
incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-svc error_rate > 5% for canary rollout v2-q5_0 (5% traffic). SLO breach candidate. Paging oncall. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/embeddings-caniary

maya: Acked. I'm on it, grabbing context and console.

sam: Started canary at 09:12 UTC, 5% traffic. Notice 5xx spike around 09:25 and kv-cache misses. logs: 
```
2024-06-10T09:25:33Z inference ERROR model_quant mismatch: requested q5 kernel not found -> runtime fallback -> exception
2024-06-10T09:25:34Z http 500 POST /v1/embeddings 0.12s
```

maya: Can you confirm rollout config? was this a model-only change or compilation tweak? @sam

sam: model binary + updated operator kernels (q5_0). It passed unit tests but integration on GPU had slight op-dispatch diff. Canary traced to node pool eu-west-1-gpu-a.

len: Any customer impact known? CS is starting to get incoming support pings.

maya: Preliminary: error rate isolated to ~2% of global requests but concentrated in EU traffic routed to that node pool. Affected endpoints: embeddings-create and batch-embed. Some PLG customers reported timeouts. No billing impact yet.

carla-support: Noted. I'll draft an outbound: "We're seeing intermittent embedding errors in EU, engineering investigating. No data loss. We'll update in 30m." Want me to send now?

maya: Hold — trying kill-switch first to stop rollout and drain canary. Command: `redwoodctl feature-flag set embeddings.model_v2_active false --env=prod`

opsbot: ACTION: feature-flag embeddings.model_v2_active set to false by maya at 09:34 UTC. Routing policy reverted to stable model_v1. Traffic shift: canary -> 0% over ~60s.

maya: Executed. Verifying traffic: `kubectl get svc embeddings-canary -o jsonpath='{.status}'` shows traffic weight 0.

sam: Initiating manual rollback of canary containers back to image @stable-20240601. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeddings-canary --to-revision=46 && kubectl scale deploy/embeddings-canary --replicas=0`

opsbot: DEPLOY: rollback started by sam. CI job #4582 triggered to reconcile deployment.

maya: Running smoke check against eu endpoint: `curl -sS -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input": "test"}'` -> returns 200 and vector length 1536. p95 latency 410ms -> back to baseline after drain.

sam: Metrics query: error_rate for embeddings in eu-west-1 dropped from 12% -> 0.6% over the last 4 minutes. p50 48ms, p95 420ms. No 500s in last 3m.

carla-support: Sent initial outbound to impacted customers with note about mitigation and upcoming RCA.

len: Thanks. Any DB or cache invalidation needed?

sam: Not required. Issue was runtime kernel dispatch; no data corruption. RCA owner: assigning to sam for root cause and remediation plan (hotfix to operator selection + integration test).

maya: I'll keep channel open for 1h for follow-up checks. Please add timeline to incident tracker and label: canary-quant-dispatch. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT: created incident CR-2024-2374 (severity: sev2). Assigned owners: sam (RCA), maya (mitigation). Follow-ups: postmortem due in 72h.
